before: In suggesting mode, row height, column divider, and table right-edge resizes wrote untracked edits.
after: They write Word tracked markup: w:trPrChange, w:tblPrChange, and w:tblGridChange beside w:tcPrChange on each cell of a changed row, under one revision per gesture. A tracked table change to a row that holds another author's pending property change is refused.
reason: Only the markup a local edit writes changes, and a refused edit writes nothing. Released replicas already preserve, replay, and resolve these row, table, and grid revision forms when they come from a file, and shared nodes, identities, offsets, and synchronization stay unchanged.
